source: Recorded with tee-cli.ts in front of `agy acp` 1.5.15 by a bare ACP client, with an empty GEMINI_HOME and SSH_CONNECTION set, so agy treats the machine as reached over SSH and has no sign-in. `session/new` answers -32000 "Authentication required". `authenticate` with oauth-personal answers at once -32603 "No browser is available here (this is a remote (SSH) session, so the browser's sign-in redirect can't reach this machine). Run `agy acp --login` in a terminal on this machine, then retry; or use a Gemini API key."; a second `session/new` is still -32000. `login` is what `agy acp --login` printed in the same home: a Google link and a prompt to paste the authorization code or the full URL of the page one lands on, then Enter. It waits on stdin; the capture stopped it after 10 s, so nothing was signed in and the home stayed empty. `t` is milliseconds from the start, `dir` is `in` for what went to agy.
